notes.title: Ver. 1.1 Major Contents Update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you for enjoying Momodora: Moonlit Farewell.
Today, we have updated to Ver. 1.1, adding multiple new features.

[h3]New boss battle[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41832743/0a4662a4348fa505f1da45601587b053e31321a4.png[/img]
An entirely new boss battle is now available to those who finished the main story. You can experience it by talking to Dora at Koho Village! Be ready for a challenge!

[h3]New Boss rush mode[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41832743/edf1daf0718ac666dedb84dcddab10f509bc53ff.png[/img]
After spending some time at the Last Layer, players will be able to meet a new character, a magi called Patata. Through her you will be able to challenge a new "Wanderlust" boss rush involving every boss encounter in one single sequence.

[h3]Revised dialogue and UI[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41832743/919ca3cc6a1d80147188e0b2134f4ec25f8a9684.png[/img]
A small revision was made to the story cutscenes near the end of Meikan Village.

Additionally, an entirely new dialogue scene has been added to further expand on Dora's story and thoughts. This new scene can be accessed at any moment at Meikan Village, even if you've already seen the credits.

The companions menu now displays a brief description of what each type does.

[h3]Expanded Fishing[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41832743/5748f970908f541f83fb7290eacd5684ebc2a623.png[/img]
A fishing menu has been added to the game to keep a record of the amount of times each fish has been caught. Since this is a new addition, it does not keep track of fishes caught previous to this update. (Sorry!)

New fishes have been added to the game. Rarer fishes have been regionalized, making them only available at specific fishing holes.

[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*]A new boss battle is now available after watching the credits
[*]A new boss rush mode has been added to The Last Layer, available after some progress is made in the zone
[*]Added some dialogue to a cutscene at the end of Meikan Village
[*]Added an entire new scene at the end of Meikan Village
[*]A fishing log has been added
[*]New fishes have been added
[*]Rarer fishes have been regionalized, making them only available at specific fishing holes
[*]The companions menu now displays a brief description of what each type does
[*]A new save point was added to the room with the matriarch
[*]Added new tutorials during the Koho Village segment in the early game
[*]Two new inventory items have been added
[*]The invincibility period once the Glazed Aegis shield breaks has been adjusted to match more closely the invincibility period length when getting hit normally
[*]Fixed an issue where some dead fairies would still remain after Sorrelia is defeated
[*]Fixed an issue where the player could go out of bounds during the fight against Plunia at the Last Layer
[*]Fixed typos
[/list]
If you haven't picked up the game yet, this is the perfect time to do so.
We hope you continue to enjoy Momodora: Moonlit Farewell!

notes.title: Update Ver.1.0f21
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you for enjoying Momodora: Moonlit Farewell.
Today, we have updated to Ver.1.0f21.

Ver.1.0f21
- The Last Layer: exclusive elements to the "Nightmare" version of bosses have been changed to inflict "Vulnerable" status on the player character and leave them at 1 HP on first hit, and kill if the player is at 1 HP
- According to the above changes, the Sigils "Glazed Aegils" and "Last Wish" will now behave as normal during "Nightmare" version of bosses
- Adjusted certain details of the first "gauntlet" of the Fairy Village segment, improving enemy layouts and preventing some of them from getting stuck in the level geometry
- Fixed an issue when, during fishing, the game would display the incorrect amount of Lunar Crystals carried by the player

Ver.1.0f20
- Added an extra key for pausing the game: Escape. This is a "fixed" (non-bindable) key and works in conjunction with the bindable default option
- Added an extra key for shooting arrows: W on keyboard, Rb on Xbox controllers, and R1 on Playstation controllers. This is a bindable key, meaning it can be changed for any other, and works in conjunction with the default option of pressing Up + Melee Attack
- Added a tutorial prompt for the pause menu in the first screen of the game

We hope you continue to enjoy Momodora: Moonlit Farewell!
